title: Property prediction + computational run
description: Set a chemist's structure–property reasoning against a declared computational run, merge the two, and loop on assumptions until they agree.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-chem-01
  title: Property prediction + computational run
  description: Set a chemist's structure–property reasoning against a declared computational run, merge
    the two, and loop on assumptions until they agree.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a candidate shortlist whose predicted properties agree between chemical reasoning and
    a declared computational method, with applicability-domain limits stated and no prediction reported
    as a measurement.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Target property profile and candidate space
      summary: Target property profile and candidate space
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - property_targets
              - candidate_structures
              - constraints
              - applicability_domain
            properties:
              property_targets: {}
              candidate_structures: {}
              constraints: {}
              applicability_domain: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-model
      kind: agent
      templateRef: chem-01
      name: Structure–property candidate reasoning
      summary: Model-side estimate with stated assumptions.
      role: Computational chemist proposing candidate structures against a property target.
      prompt: You are a Molecular Design Chemist. You propose candidate structures against an explicit
        property profile, stating the structure–property reasoning and the applicability domain of any
        model you rely on. You mark a predicted property as predicted, never as measured, and you flag
        candidates that sit outside the training domain of the model that suggested them rather than ranking
        them as if they were equally supported.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:chem-database
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-run
      kind: tool
      name: Computational property run
      summary: Host-supplied quantum chemistry or cheminformatics calculation. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it, and no result may be reported as measured.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:chem-database
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-compare
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge estimate and instrument run
      summary: Merge the two result objects; every field where they disagree is surfaced as a collision
        rather than silently overwritten.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score agreement
      summary: Evaluate agreement on property ranking and whether candidates fall inside the applicability
        domain.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agreement on property ranking and whether candidates
        fall inside the applicability domain. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the
        verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-converged
      kind: condition
      name: Converged?
      summary: Route on fit.passed.
      config:
        expression: fit.passed
        branches:
          - label: Converged
            when: 'true'
          - label: Refine
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-refine
      kind: loop
      name: Refine assumptions until agreement
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until agreement between the estimate and the instrument
        run meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-model
          - n-run
          - n-compare
          - n-fit
          - n-converged
        exitCondition: agreement between the estimate and the instrument run meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Principal investigator approves the shortlist for synthesis planning
      summary: Pause for the principal investigator; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Property prediction + computational run deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-model
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-run
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-3
      from: n-model
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-4
      from: n-run
      to: n-compare
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-5
      from: n-compare
      to: n-fit
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-6
      from: n-fit
      to: n-converged
      kind: data
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-7
      from: n-converged
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-8
      from: n-converged
      to: n-refine
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-9
      from: n-refine
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-chem-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
